definitions.meaning: Land on which mast is produced

quotations.old_english: Eall ðæt wudu&dash-uncertain;lond ðæt Æþelbald gesealde tó mæstlonde

source_text: mæst-land, es; n. Land on which mast is produced :-- Eall ðæt wudu&dash-uncertain;lond ðæt Æþelbald gesealde tó mæstlonde. Chart. Th. 140, 2.
